trials.summary: w1_2d (sigma_weight 0.4092) reaches objective 0.0895, about 0.009 worse than the KDE control 0.0803, with no divergences and error concentrated in the low-count mu channel.
trials.key_insight: The bandwidth-free W1 loss is fully stable (no mu runaway, gamma finite) but recovers low-count mu worse than the KDE control, so it has not yet earned its keep.

trials.summary: energy_2d (sigma_weight 0.4228) reaches objective 0.0996, worse than trial_01 w1_2d (0.0895) and the KDE control (0.0803), no divergences, with a systematic low-count gamma undershoot.
trials.key_insight: The energy distance is stable but undershoots gamma in the low-count cells, making it the weakest loss form tested so far.

trials.summary: mmd_2d (sigma_weight 0.4331) reaches objective 0.1833, far worse than w1_2d (0.0895), energy_2d (0.0996) and the KDE control (0.0803), with mu low almost everywhere and no divergences.
trials.key_insight: With the median-heuristic MMD kernel the mu reward is systematically too weak, leaving mu far below truth at every transmission; MMD is the weakest loss form tested.

trials.summary: w1_fwhm (sigma_weight 0.5113) reaches objective 0.0908, statistically identical to the two-channel w1_2d (0.0895) and still worse than the KDE control (0.0803), with no divergences.
trials.key_insight: Dropping the sigma channel from the W1 loss changes the result essentially not at all (0.0908 vs 0.0895), so the W1 shortfall is a property of the FWHM loss itself, not of the sigma link.

trials.summary: cvm_fwhm (sigma_weight 0.2345) reaches objective 0.0777, a new campaign best that edges past the KDE control (0.0803), driven by the best gamma recovery of any trial.
trials.key_insight: A FWHM-only Cramer-von Mises loss currently beats the KDE control, with the gain coming from the gamma channel rather than mu, which stays low at high T.

trials.summary: cvm_fwhm (sigma_weight 0.2074) improves the campaign best to objective 0.0764, reproducing the family win over the KDE control (0.0803) with the best gamma of the campaign.
trials.key_insight: The cvm_fwhm advantage is reproducible across two seeds (0.0777 then 0.0764) and its benefit lives in the gamma channel, while mu stays at the same rel ~33 percent level as every other family.

trials.summary: The KDE control at sigma_weight 0.2279 gives objective 0.0830, no better than its own reference (0.0803) and clearly behind cvm_fwhm (0.0764), so the low-sw region does not by itself produce the gain.
trials.key_insight: The cvm_fwhm advantage is a genuine loss-FORM effect, not a sigma_weight-region artifact: KDE moved to the same sw stays at control level.

protocol.model: series-21 (17g) model on REAL data; the mu reward and the gamma pathwise channel are both derived from the selected distributional LOSS (loss_family); mu score denominator = per-experiment sigma_prop (MU_SCORE=sigma_prop)
protocol.question: experiment_8 - loss-FUNCTION campaign: the schedule (exp5 winner), the bandwidth (exp7 winner) and the gamma trust region (exp6 winner) are FROZEN; the campaign tunes the distributional loss (loss_family) and the sigma-channel weight (sigma_weight).
protocol.no_clipping: CLIP = inf AND parameter clamps removed (mu/gamma unbounded)

divergence_guard.note: STOP the experiment and record diverged/diverged_at if a parameter leaves this band

protocol.objective: T-weighted mean of CAP-capped per-cell rel-sq errors; err_i = min(rel_sq_i, CAP=1.0); w(T) = 0.25 + 0.75*T/100; objective = sum(w*err)/sum(w)

budget.held_out: 6 exps (1nW/3nW x Trans10/40/80) - post-campaign validation only

frozen: z-form gamma-score convention (kept for the control)
tunable: loss_family   choice  kde | w1_2d | energy_2d | mmd_2d | w1_fwhm | cvm_fwhm
sigma_weight  float   0.0 .. 1.0   (weight of the sigma_fit channel: loss = loss_FWHM + sw*loss_sigma)

families.kde: 2-D KDE negative log-likelihood (exp5/6/7 design) - CONTROL, reproduces exp6 0.0803
families.w1_2d: Wasserstein-1 (sorted quantile matching) on FWHM + sigma_fit - bandwidth-free
families.energy_2d: energy distance on FWHM + sigma_fit - bandwidth-free
families.mmd_2d: RBF-kernel MMD^2 over the 2-D cloud, median-heuristic kernel width (per step)
families.w1_fwhm: Wasserstein-1 on FWHM only (drops the sigma link) - control
families.cvm_fwhm: Cramer-von Mises-style squared quantile distance on FWHM only - control

protocol.family_scale: each family is multiplied by FAMILY_SCALE so its |d(loss)/dgamma| at the frozen start matches the KDE control (compares the loss FORM, not its scale)
protocol.success_bar: beat the experiment_6 level (objective ~0.086, best 0.0803) on the same T-weighted capped metric, with gamma finite on all 8 cells; the winner must ALSO hold on the 6 held-out experiments.
